name: SEO Help Flow for ACF and Elementor
author: SEO HelpMarketing

sections.description:
If you build sites with Elementor + Advanced Custom Fields, you already know the pain: great content in ACF, beautiful layout in Elementor—but wiring them together often means shortcodes, fragile templates, or custom PHP you do not want to maintain.

SEO Help Flow fixes that. It is a native Elementor integration for ACF: pick fields in the panel, see them on the canvas, ship faster, check broken field connections, and keep structured data close to the content your editors already maintain.

From SEO Help Marketing — built for agencies, freelancers, and teams who care about SEO that matches real content, not duplicate “SEO boxes.”

Why this stack benefits from a dedicated bridge

  • One workflow — editors update ACF; designers stay in Elementor; you stop duplicating text between “content” and “SEO fields.”
  • Template Health checks — scan Elementor templates and pages for missing or renamed ACF fields before clients find broken layouts.
  • Client-safe handoff — map approved field groups and hide layout-editing shortcuts for client roles.
  • Structured data without copy-paste — output Article, FAQPage, WebPage, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD from ACF repeaters and text fields where it makes sense.

What you can build today 🎯

  • ACF widgets for Elementor — Text, Dynamic Text, Heading, Image, Link, Button Advanced, Gallery, Author Meta, Read Time, TOC, CTA Banner and more.
  • ACF Repeater — grids, lists, sliders; template-driven rows without leaving Elementor.
  • Template Health — a practical checker for Elementor + ACF field connections.
  • Client-Safe Mode — agency handoff controls for safer client editing.
  • SEO Intent Blocks — Local Service, FAQ, Blog Article, Comparison and Testimonial workflows with ACF contracts.
  • ACF JSON-LD (SEO) — map fields to schema.org so search engines see the same story visitors see.
  • Site Blueprint — export field contracts, template health and workflow settings for reuse across agency projects.

Who it is for

  • Agencies shipping many Elementor + ACF sites and needing a repeatable pattern.
  • Developers who want maintainable dynamic UI—not one-off hacks per project.
  • SEO-minded builders who want valid, maintainable structured data tied to CMS fields.

Works with your existing SEO plugin?

Often yes. Avoid publishing two competing JSON-LD blocks for the same thing on the same URL (e.g. two FAQ schemas). Pick one source per schema type—this plugin, or Yoast / Rank Math / etc.—and stay consistent.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+ · PHP 7.4+ · Elementor + Advanced Custom Fields (see Requires Plugins).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields (required).
  2. Install SEO Help Flow for ACF and Elementor from Plugins → Add New (search) or upload the ZIP.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open any page or template in Elementor.
  5. In the widget panel, open the Help Flow category (label may reflect your white-label setting).
  6. Drag a widget (e.g. ACF Text), select the ACF field to use, preview, publish.

Next step: In wp-admin, open the plugin’s Getting Started page for links, tips, and links to documentation.
sections.faq:
Do I need both Elementor and ACF?

Yes. The plugin is built specifically for sites that use Elementor for layout and Advanced Custom Fields for structured content. Both are listed under Requires Plugins.

How does the plugin help SEO if it is not a classic SEO plugin?

It connects your real content (ACF) to structured data and semantic output in Elementor. Instead of pasting static JSON-LD or duplicating text in a separate SEO box, you can drive Article, FAQ, WebPage, and breadcrumb schema from fields you already maintain—so SEO stays closer to what users see on the page.

Is everything free on WordPress.org?

Yes. Every widget and feature in this WordPress.org build is available without paying. No feature is locked behind an upgrade inside this distribution.

How is this different from generic dynamic tags or shortcodes?

You get dedicated ACF widgets plus agency workflow tools: Template Health, Client-Safe Mode, SEO Intent Blocks and Site Blueprint export—not one generic tag for everything.

Can I use this with other SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, etc.)?

In many cases, yes. Avoid outputting conflicting duplicate JSON-LD for the same entity on the same page. Pick one source of truth per schema type (for example, either your SEO plugin or ACF JSON-LD (SEO) for FAQ)—whichever matches your workflow.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. Text domain: seohelp-flow-for-acf-and-elementor. Community translations can be contributed via translate.wordpress.org when available.

Will this slow down my site?

The plugin follows WordPress patterns for scripts and styles. As with any Elementor site, keep third-party widgets reasonable and test with your host and caching setup.

screenshots.caption: Help Flow in Elementor — the widget category with ACF Text, ACF Dynamic Text, Conditional Logic, ACF Image, ACF Link/Button, ACF Gallery, and ACF JSON-LD (SEO).
Core widgets in the panel — quick access to ACF Text, ACF Dynamic Text, ACF Repeater Builder, and Conditional Logic from the same category.
Edit ACF Text — Content tab: choose the ACF field (e.g. Text, Text Area), set the HTML tag (e.g. a paragraph), and options like Hide if empty.
ACF Repeater Builder — map a Repeater or Flexible field, pick an Elementor template for each row, and lay out items in a grid (columns, gap, responsive controls).
Conditional Logic — define when a block shows: conditions such as equals, not equals, is empty, or is not empty on the selected ACF field.
More field types in one widget — ACF Field dropdown including Text, Number, Text Area, and Image, plus control of the output HTML tag.
Insert imported templates — starter sections (Hero, features, CTA layouts, and more); one click adds them to the Elementor library and creates the ACF Flow Starter field group automatically.
